about.title: About the Brilliant Stars set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Brilliant Stars is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 25 February 2022. It has 186 cards: 172 in the main set and 14 secret rares. There are also 124 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 172 main set cards), the Master set (296 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 310 cards, adding the 14 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
